Public kits are from 2026-10-01; hidden inventory and kits are from 2026-09-30. Refresh before implementation.
Counts are linked records, not a certification of independent acquisition, item availability or mode legality.
The 35 other hidden records are deferred outside this approved public batch; this is not a finding that every hidden record is custom or permanently ineligible.
